notes:
REF-BM-02: Derives a favicon URL at display time but does not collect page title, description, or preview image.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, description, and tags are editable, but notes are unsupported.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are inserted as new rows without detection or edit guidance.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain text field with no autocomplete.
REF-BM-12: Search covers title, description, and URL, but there is no note field.
REF-BM-14: The search endpoint does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised search groups are unsupported.
REF-BM-16: Quoted phrases receive no exact-match parsing.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: Bookmarks cannot be marked read.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action support.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Ordering is fixed; users cannot choose a sort key.
REF-BM-23: Bookmark notes and markdown rendering are unsupported.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML or PDF snapshot is created.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshots are unsupported.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Archive/restore is absent, so archive cannot be distinguished from deletion.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: Bundles and reusable saved filters are unsupported.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is unsupported.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is unsupported.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings are provided.
